en: Color postcard showing a central square with a large domed building, a former mosque now church, in the middle. In the foreground are flower beds, steps, and people walking or sitting. On the left stands a tall Baroque-style column, and on the right an equestrian statue on a high pedestal. The sky is clear blue. The word "PÉCS" is printed in white at the top left on the front. The reverse side is a standard divided-back postcard layout with blue address lines and red stamp boxes, and printed information about the place and photographer.
